title: Block 3: Upgrade the Strategist Prompt and Parser to generate relatio
description: Upgrade the Strategist Prompt and Parser to generate relational deep-tree decompositions instead of flat arrays. [Acceptance Criteria: Strategist output is parsed into a flat array of `FractalNode` objects with valid `TaxonomyTier` identifiers (MACRO, MESO, MICRO) and valid `parentId` pointers, which are directly injected into the normalized state.]
